title: 7 tax refunds Indians in Germany miss
Why you miss them
body: As an employee in tax class 1 you usually don't HAVE to file a tax return.
So many expats never do – and the tax office keeps money that could be yours.
You can file voluntarily for the last 4 years.

title: Money you send to your parents in India
body: Up to €3,087 per parent a year can be deducted (2026).
Pay by bank transfer, get a signed support form (Unterhaltserklärung).
foot: §33a EStG, India = country group 4. Reduced if parents have own income or savings.

title: Your move from India
body: Moved to Germany for your job? Flights, shipping and other moving costs can count as work costs (Werbungskosten).
foot: Keep every receipt and your work contract.

title: Your way to work
body: New in 2026: €0.38 per km from the first km.
foot: Only the part above the €1,230 employee allowance brings extra money back.

title: Working from home
body: €6 per home-office day, up to €1,260 a year (210 days).

title: Repairs and your Nebenkosten bill
body: 20% of labour costs back, up to €1,200 a year (craftsmen).
Caretaker, cleaning, garden service in your Nebenkosten: 20% back too – also for renters.

title: Your wife or husband joined you
body: Married and your partner earns little or nothing yet? Joint taxation (Splitting) can mean several thousand euros less tax a year.
Tax class 3 gives it to you every month.
foot: Example: €72k salary, partner no income ≈ €500 a month more. Partner must live in Germany/EU.

title: Laptop and phone for work
body: Work laptop: can be deducted in full in the year you buy it.
Phone and internet: the part you use for work.

title: Send this to a friend who never filed a tax return
body: Save it for your next return.
foot: Rules as of Nov 2026. General information, no tax advice – please ask a tax advisor. Arenja & Raj Finanz GmbH – Immobiliardarlehensvermittler §34i GewO, Versicherungsmakler §34d GewO.
